_comment: Game 1.6 (OS) hand decisions for symbols tools/matcher16.py left at 0x0 or matched with low confidence (see dumps_ref/1.6/unresolved.txt and REPORT-matching.md). Entries: {"NAME": {"rva": "0x...", "note": "why / how verified"}}. Applied by tools/apply_overrides.py --ver 16 onto appdata-16/il2cpp-functions.h, il2cpp-types-ptr.h and il2cpp-unityplayer-functions.h (only lines whose offset is 0x0). Re-run after gen_appdata16.py, which rewrites those headers from match16.json.

MoleMole_InLevelMapPageContext_UpdateVie.note: BPDBBEDHBCP$$ODHLJNAONMH, 1.6 dump.cs:1812713 (public void, instance). 1.6 has NO UpdateView override: BaseContext's slot 26 is an empty hotfix stub, so the symbol is repurposed for the method that runs right after the view rect is written. FEIBBKAODPE @0xAEF790 is the only non-ctor writer of InLevelMapPageContext._mapViewRect @0x1D0 (it is MonoExUICamera.onViewChange, registered by BABICAFOOCO @0xAD99A0) and calls ADPLIDADADC then ODHLJNAONMH on every normal path after the write; ODHLJNAONMH has exactly one caller and no delegate reference. The hook (InteractiveMap.cpp, copies __this->fields._mapViewRect after CALL_ORIGIN) needs no change. Fallback of the same shape: ADPLIDADADC @0x00AD44B0. Note: the delegate is not invoked while MonoExUICamera.allowCameraAnimation (+0x170) is set, so the rect does not refresh during camera animations. 2.8 twin ELBPCIGIBIH$$EMBMMLLJHOM 0x034D6410.

MoleMole_InLevelMainPageContext_get_mini.note: KCFCJJBPLEN$$MKLHNEKDNCJ, 1.6 dump.cs:1808326 (public float, instance): IFix gate then movss xmm0,[rcx+0x4B8] - the only float() reader of _miniMapScale in the class, and the class is right (MonoMiniMap.context is typed KCFCJJBPLEN in the 1.6 dump; 'IGKEDHHIDMA' does not exist there). SECTR_StreamingLevel_BuildLayerTables.note: OICEICPMMLN$$OAFMCJKHPCK, 1.6 dump.cs:1962790 (RVA 0xEF44B0): builds the level's layer tables from get_SceneSplitterConfig - Dictionary<string, SECTR_LayerConfig> 0x68, name -> index 0x70, the cached per-layer load radii 0x78-0x90 (max of stored and config) - the body of the public BGJLCFNOJFK @0xEF2050 (a plain jump), run by the game when the level is created. RenderDistance.cpp re-runs it after every loadSize write: the level had been built from an earlier splitter-config instance than the one the getter hands out later (the job probe showed jobs copying the stock 80 m while the getter's config held ours). Matched to 2.8's NJPNGIPLALM.PLDOADEOPIG @0x34A33C0 (the same List<SECTR_LayerConfig> sort + FindIndex + dictionary fills).

QualitySettings_set_shadowCascade4Split.note: UnityEngine.QualitySettings$$set_shadowCascade4Split, 1.6 dump.cs:366036 (RVA 0x52CAA20). STATIC and HOOKED by visuals/RenderDistance.cpp (the split is divided by the multiplier whenever the distance is multiplied), so like set_shadowDistance it keeps its name with the leading dummy `this` and the handler carries RELIC_STATIC_THIS. Vector3 by value = hidden reference in rdx (the quality applier FPOAEFCHAMD.AKJJJLAOBDG @0x2738660 passes rcx = 0, rdx = &split, r8 = 0).

QualitySettings_get_shadowCascade4Split.note: UnityEngine.QualitySettings$$get_shadowCascade4Split, 1.6 dump.cs:366033 (RVA 0x52CA400). STATIC -> __RAW + inline thunk. Returns Vector3 through the hidden pointer in rcx with the dummy this in rdx (its caller LJODCBINFMP.BDEJJPNHDDN @0x2A72280 passes rcx = &out, edx = 0, r8 = 0). Read once by visuals/RenderDistance.cpp so the cascade split can be divided before the game writes it again.

SECTR_Streaming_LoadSplitterConfig.note: JBPNDKLFIFM$$KJLFHILAMPB(string path), 1.6 dump.cs:1961711 (RVA 0x362E9C0): loads the SECTR_SceneSplitterConfig asset by path into the holder's static (String.op_Equality reuse, DismissExternal of the old one, SortConfigs) - called by the level creation DKKCBPEDPHF.IDMAGIJGNOP @0x1487220 right before the level and its sector tree are built. The per-sector streaming jobs copy their layer's loadSize from the config at that build and never re-read it, so visuals/RenderDistance.cpp HOOKS this call and writes the radii into the freshly loaded config before returning. STATIC and HOOKED -> keeps its name with the dummy `this`; matched to 2.8's KIFKAIFDIIC.FOEPCDHKLJB by the same ConcatString('Data/LevelStreamingConfig/SplitterConfig/') caller shape.
